summary.intent: Rewrite the CipherBox README to strip outdated v1 details and reword it for v2, targeting humans building or researching the system.
summary.outcome: README.md was rewritten against the v2 blueprint corpus and committed; while verifying references, an inconsistency was found where the landing/ site used npm instead of the repo's pnpm workspace convention, so it was migrated to pnpm and both render.yaml and the deploy-landing.yml CI workflow were updated to match.

repo: The v2 blueprint corpus is the authoritative source for the target workspace layout, crate list, and API stack (including the roles of crates/wasm and crates/fuse) — used to ground the README rewrite instead of relying on existing docs.
The rest of the monorepo is a pnpm workspace, but landing/ was still using npm with its own package-lock.json — a drift from convention.
Both render.yaml and .github/workflows/deploy-landing.yml independently referenced landing's npm-based build/cache, so fixing the package manager required updating all three locations in tandem.
ci.yml contains the repo's standard pnpm setup pattern, which was copied into deploy-landing.yml as the template for the fix.
workflow: `pnpm import` against a package-lock.json inside a workspace can fail outright; retrying with `--ignore-workspace` and then reverting the root lockfile before doing a standalone import for the subpackage was the working sequence.

After migrating a subproject's package manager, grep the whole repo for other references to the old setup — the CI workflow's npm/lockfile cache reference wasn't caught until an explicit follow-up search.
A zsh glob pattern aborted a search command mid-task, requiring a re-run with adjusted quoting before the CI workflow issue was found.

friction: Initial `pnpm import` of landing's package-lock.json failed inside the workspace context, requiring a fallback (--ignore-workspace) and a revert of unintended root lockfile changes.
A zsh glob abort interrupted the repo-wide grep for other npm/landing references, requiring a manual re-run to surface the deploy-landing.yml issue.
Task scope expanded from a documentation cleanup into an unplanned landing-site package-manager migration and CI workflow edit.
open_items: Only README.md appears in the reported Files Modified list despite render.yaml, deploy-landing.yml, and landing/'s package.json and lockfiles also being edited — verify these are committed/staged as intended.
Confirm no other CI or deploy configuration still references the deleted landing package-lock.json.
